Every shipped file is classified; profile, sampling and historical acceptance gaps have named owners. Repairs and convergence are not claimed.

charter.question: Owns
charter.answer: Operator commands, application introspection adapters, scaffolding/site generation and management-plan workflows.
charter.evidence: packages/cli/composer.json; README; production inventory and current composition.

charter.question: Does not own
charter.answer: Domain persistence, authorization policy, schema transition authority and kernel composition contracts that commands invoke.
charter.evidence: Peer package contracts and existing issue ownership.

charter.question: Consumers
charter.answer: Installed ConsoleKernel applications, waaseyaa/cms, generated projects and operators.
charter.evidence: Composer inbound inventory and source entrypoints.

charter.question: Dependencies
charter.answer: Symfony Console/Finder and a broad content/presentation closure. Optional AI, MCP and OIDC integrations are distinct from hard requirements; #2821 owns remaining CLI closure reduction.

charter.question: Public surface
charter.answer: Command names/options, exit statuses and machine-readable outputs, handlers/provider registrations, generated artifacts and plan digests.

charter.question: Installation profiles
charter.answer: Source, kernel and framework closure are distinguished from standalone split and generated-application qualification. Fresh installed evidence is incomplete.
